title: Immich
subtitle: Link photos from your own Immich instance
apiKeyPlaceholder: Create one in Immich under Account → API Keys
apiKeyScopes: Required permissions: album.read, asset.read, asset.view, asset.download, user.read. album.read alone is not enough — an album's pictures sit behind the asset permissions. Read-only; TravStats needs nothing beyond that.
modeLinkHint: Photos stay in Immich — no extra storage.
modeImportHint: Photos are copied and included in backups.

albums.hiddenSelections: {{count}} selected album is hidden by your search
albums.hiddenSelections_other: {{count}} selected albums are hidden by your search
albums.importFailed: The import stopped – {{reason}} Photos already copied are kept.
albums.importFailedUnknown: An unknown error occurred while copying the photos.
albums.importPartial: {{failed}} of {{total}} photos could not be copied. "Re-sync" tries them again.

errors.notFound: Album not found — was it deleted in Immich?
errors.protocol: Unexpected response from Immich. Does the server version match?
errors.invalidUrl: The server URL is not valid.
errors.keyRequired: Testing a different server address needs your own API key. The instance-wide key is only valid for the server it was configured for.

admin.title: Immich (instance-wide)
admin.subtitle: One Immich instance for every user. Anyone who configures their own overrides it.
admin.apiKeyHint: The stored key is only ever shown masked. Leave it untouched to keep it.
admin.loadFailed: Could not load the Immich settings. They can only be edited once they have loaded.

nightlyScan.title: Nightly photo scan
nightlyScan.subtitle: Finds trips, stays and visits in your Immich library that are not in the logbook yet.
nightlyScan.switch: Scan for photo journeys every night
nightlyScan.what: Reads the photos of the last {{days}} days every night, next run: {{next}}. Findings appear as suggestions in the inbox under “Photo journeys” — nothing is recorded until you accept it.
nightlyScan.privacy: Pictures never leave Immich; only the positions of findings go to the place-name service.
nightlyScan.privacyHelp: To name a finding, the server asks the place-name service (Nominatim, Photon) what is at that position — at most 40 or 20 requests per run.
nightlyScan.privacyHelpMore: The scan runs on your server with your own Immich connection. A scan of the whole library can be started any time in the inbox with “Scan photos”.
nightlyScan.notConnected: No Immich connection — the nightly scan skips this account until one is set up above.
nightlyScan.loadFailed: The setting could not be loaded.
nightlyScan.saveFailedOn: Could not be saved — the nightly scan stays on.
nightlyScan.saveFailedOff: Could not be saved — the nightly scan stays off.

lastRun.never: No nightly scan has run for this account yet.
lastRun.noImmich: Last nightly run {{when}}: skipped — no Immich connection.
lastRun.failed: Last nightly run {{when}} failed: {{reason}} The next night tries again.
lastRun.internal: Internal error on the server (see the server log).

nightlyScan.manualNote: Only the nightly run is shown here. “Scan photos” in the inbox reports its own result there, with the reason if Immich does not answer.
nightlyScan.notConnectedDemo: The demo account has no photo library — the nightly scan does not run for it.
